{{Quote|Flashy can bulls-eye a savrip between the eyes five times before the critter even knows it's dead.|Corso Riggs, on his blaster, "Flashy"|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Flashy''' was the [[SSK heavy blaster]] owned by [[Corso Riggs]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Corso later gave Flashy to the smuggler known as the [[Voidhound]] to aid said smuggler's search for [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]] in a Separatist stronghold located in a volcano. According to Corso, Flashy is one of Corso's named weapons, along with Hewey, Sparkles and Torchy.

==Behind the scenes==
Flashy is a blaster pistol that can be used in the Smuggler Class in the [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing]] [[Star Wars video games|game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. A player who completes a class mission receives Flashy as a mission reward. Flashy can be modified like all weapons received just before leaving Beginning Planets ([[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Hutta]], and [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]).
